## Summary

Built and locally verified the OAuth 2.1 consent flow (PSI-074). CODE: src/app/auth/consent/page.tsx (client page: reads authorization_id, gates on session via supabase.auth.getUser, calls auth.oauth.getAuthorizationDetails, shows client name/logo + user email + scopes, Approve via approveAuthorization / Deny via denyAuthorization with skipBrowserRedirect then router.replace to the returned redirect_url; auto-redirects when already consented; handles missing/invalid authorization_id); src/app/auth/consent/consent-lib.ts (pure formatScopes + resolveConsentState + signInUrlForConsent, unit-tested); 6 unit tests. CONFIG: supabase/config.toml [auth.oauth_server] enabled=true, authorization_url_path=/auth/consent, allow_dynamic_registration=true. VERIFIED LOCALLY against the running stack (supabase start): OAuth server metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (issuer, authorize/token/userinfo/registration endpoints); JWKS is ES256 asymmetric; dynamic client registration returns a client_id; authorize with PKCE + admin@p3md.test session 302-redirects to http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/consent?authorization_id=...; getAuthorizationDetails returns {client{name}, user{email}, scope} exactly as the consent page consumes; PKCE enforced (missing code_challenge -> invalid_request). ## Decisions

- **Use supabase.auth.getUser() (client) for the session gate, not server-only getSession**: Consent page is a client component under /auth (public prefix); getUser matches the notifications-page pattern.
- **skipBrowserRedirect:true + router.replace in approve/deny**: Control the redirect in-app (and keep a fallback to /dashboard/overview if no URL) rather than letting Supabase auto-redirect.
- **Enable OAuth server locally in config.toml**: Agent-doable config that mirrors the hosted requirement; lets the full authorize→consent→approve flow be exercised deterministically. Hosted settings remain human (no credentials).
